validity.weather_disruption_notice: 강풍·비바람 등 기상 상황에 따라 안전 운항을 위해 일시적으로 운항이 중단될 수 있습니다.

representation.blank_cell_rule: null preserves an empty source cell; do not infer its operational meaning
representation.row_alignment_rule: Source layout only. The same row across columns is not an established trip relationship.
representation.event_type_rule: Direction headings are departures; columns explicitly headed 도착 are arrivals.
representation.stop_id_authority: Local identifiers assigned for this dataset; not operator-issued IDs.

source_notes: 표기된 시간은 각 선착장 출발 시간 기준입니다.

source_diagram.use_rule: Displayed minutes are used for nominal arrival estimates under arrival_estimation_policy. Diagram spans are not certified stop-call sequences or operational routing edges.

verification.scope: Published image transcription and arithmetic of nominal arrival estimates; not actual arrival, operational availability or trip linkage certification.

arrival_estimation_policy.formula: estimated_arrival = selected_origin_departure + sum(displayed_minutes for diagram spans between origin and destination)
arrival_estimation_policy.decision_basis: User-selected estimation method when same-trip linkage cannot be confirmed.
arrival_estimation_policy.time_base: Only the selected origin departure; intermediate-stop departure times are not joined or substituted.
arrival_estimation_policy.direction_rule: Generate only destinations between the origin and the terminal named by its source departure heading.
arrival_estimation_policy.reverse_direction_rule: Reuse the same displayed minutes in both directions as a project estimation assumption, not a confirmed direction-specific duration.
arrival_estimation_policy.nonadjacent_duration_rule: Sum intervening diagram labels even if a stop is bypassed; this is a nominal estimate, not a published duration for the bypass service.
arrival_estimation_policy.stop_call_rule: An estimate does not confirm a stop call for that departure. Calls at Oksu and Apgujeong require separate confirmation.
arrival_estimation_policy.official_arrival_rule: Explicit source arrival columns are preserved separately and never overwritten or paired with departures without confirmed trip linkage.
arrival_estimation_policy.day_offset_rule: arrival_day_offset is the number of local calendar days after the selected departure's date.
arrival_estimation_policy.blank_cell_rule: No arrival estimate is generated from an empty source departure cell.
